$about: The Protected List of `04-ux-flows.md` §7, made machine-readable.
§8: 'The Protected List is executable, or it is not protected.' Rule 1 there is
the one this file exists to enforce — NO MVP ITEM MAY BE MARKED DONE WHILE ITS
PROTECTED ASSERTION IS SKIPPED. Until this file existed there was nothing that
could tell 'covered by a test' apart from 'nobody has looked', which is exactly
the classic failure §8 describes: the feature ships, the test is disabled
'temporarily', and the detail is gone by the time anyone runs a demo.
So every item carries a STATUS and it is checked by scripts/protected-list.test.ts:
covered  — names a test id that must exist in the suite. A typo fails the build.
blocked  — names what blocks it. An empty blocker fails the build.
partial  — the feature exists in part; `missing` lists what does not, in words.
`partial` is deliberately NOT a passing state. It is here so a half-built item
reads as half-built instead of quietly counting as done, and so the gap is a
sentence somebody wrote rather than a silence somebody has to notice.

items.title: The call-state banner covering the 5-15 silent seconds of a two-legged dial
items.blocker: The Aloware module (Sprint 1 item 9) and its recorded cassettes. Sprint-0 Gate 2 needs the real account, which is Jorge's to obtain.

items.title: The board REFUSES the drop into an earning column and opens the win gate
note: §8 requires this on EVERY surface including the raw API, so the assertion is
not only the drag. The database CHECK is the subject: a test that passed by
mocking a service layer would prove nothing.

items.title: Owner-scoped not-found — a pasted foreign record URL, never a 403
note: The full requirement is broader than this test: §8 wants the route table
enumerated so a new route with no foreign-id assertion cannot merge. The
route registry that would drive it does not exist yet. What is asserted here
is the demo-visible behaviour on the routes that do exist.

items.title: Zero-effort call logging and the wrap-up sheet that opens by itself
items.blocker: The Aloware module. The sheet opens on banner close, and there is no banner without call state.

items.title: One server-side compliance gate that hard-blocks outside the lead-local calling window
items.blocker: Needs the dial path (Aloware) and `lead_local_tz` on the contact, which arrives with the intake module. The scheduling layer already snapshots a contact timezone; nothing dials yet.

items.title: The kanban card as the whole status report — six facts without opening anything
missing: The card renders three of the six: annualised premium, days untouched, and the next activity.
Absent: lead source (lead_source_id is deliberately deferred to the intake module), attempt count, and the health signal with its suppression rule.
Also unasserted: the fixed card height (120px desktop / 156px mobile) that 05c ties to the ui.card_h_* pinned ratchet.

items.title: Global owner-scoped search, Cmd/Ctrl+K, under 200ms perceived
items.blocker: Not built. There is no search endpoint, no prefix cache and no E.164 normalisation yet.

items.title: The honest go-live board: fifty names, fifty $0, the footnote, and the activity strip
missing: The board does include a seller with no ledger row at $0 — migration 0017 fixed the join that hid them, and the leaderboard suite covers it.

Absent: the permanent 'The board starts at go-live' footnote, the 'Earnings tracked since' label, the distinct per-period empty copy, and the today activity strip (dials / contacts / appointments), which is the only number that moves before the first sale.

items.title: The first ten seconds: Demo chip, first-run checklist, My Day counts, rank and gap above the fold
missing: My Day renders its four sections with counts in the header, and the seed is separately tenanted and refuses to run twice.
Absent: the persistent 'Demo' chip in the shell, the 'Demo tenant — these numbers are seeded' board footnote, the four-item first-run checklist, and the rank-and-gap line above the fold.
The seed refuses to DUPLICATE but does not yet refuse to run in a live environment: that needs `system_constant`, which does not exist.
